title: Tidal perturbations and Love Symmetry for five-dimensional charged rotating black holes
summary: We investigate the tidal response of general five-dimensional (5D) black holes of STU supergravity, which include as special cases important solutions such as the Myers-Perry, BMPV, 5D Reissner-Nordström, Kerr-Newman and dyonic black holes. Solutions are parameterized by their mass, two angular momenta and up to three $U(1)$ charges. Love numbers and dissipation coefficients are obtained in the static and dynamic cases.
